title: Binance Charity to Donate $35,000 in USDT to Support Users Affected by the Ghana Floods
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Following the devastating floods that struck Accra in June, Binance Charity is donating  a total of $35,000 in USDT token vouchers  to help Binance users living in areas affected by the tragedy based on Proof of Address. Donation Details: Existing Binance users in eligible areas have until  2026-07-20 23:59 (UTC)  to complete their Proof of Address to qualify for the donation of 15 USDT, subject to the total donation allocation. Funds will be distributed   to eligible users  within 30 days of POA completion . Eligible Areas: Users identified through Proof of Address (POA) in the most affected areas will  each receive 15 USDT in token vouchers , redeemable via their  Rewards Hub . The eligible areas are: N1 Highway Kasoa Kwame Nkrumah Circle Alajo Tse Addo Kaneshie Adabraka Tesano Mallam Weija Achimota Madina Spintex Darkuman How to Qualify: Users in the affected regions who have already completed their Proof of Address will  automatically  qualify for the donation.  Users who have not yet completed their POA can still qualify by completing their Proof of Address  before 2026-07-20 23:59 (UTC). Any POA submissions made after  2026-07-20 23:59 (UTC)  will  not  be eligible for the airdrop. Funds will be distributed  within 30 days  from the day of POA completion. About Binance Charity: Binance Charity has previously supported communities affected by disasters across Argentina, Brazil, DRC, Italy, Libya, Mexico, Morocco, Taiwan, Turkey, Uganda, Ukraine, and Venezuela. As recovery efforts continue in Ghana, we remain committed to standing with our users and will continue to work on additional ways to help our community. For more information, please visit our  FAQ page . Thank you for your continued trust in Binance Charity.
